source.title: Astronaut Bone Health Handbook v7 — Biology for Developers (GR)

interpretationSafety: Handbook evidence tiers A/B/C are author-assigned and do not establish independent clinical or flight validation.
No diagnosis, clinical cutoffs, fracture-risk predictions or automated readiness scoring.
Compare longitudinal observations only when specimen, assay, method, unit, site and modality are compatible.
CTX relative change is not percentage bone loss; BMD retention is not fracture risk.
Associations between exercise, radiation, biomarkers and BMD are not automatically causal.
